Prompt

Create a personal trainer portfolio website for a fitness coach named "Alex Rivera". Include these sections:

1. HERO SECTION
- Professional photo of the trainer in action
- Name and title: "Alex Rivera - Certified Personal Trainer & Nutrition Coach"
- Tagline: "Helping you become the strongest version of yourself"
- CTA buttons: "Book Free Consultation" and "View Programs"
- Social media links (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok)

2. ABOUT SECTION
- Personal story and fitness journey
- Training philosophy
- Professional photo (different from hero)
- Years of experience highlight
- Personality-driven, relatable copy

3. CREDENTIALS & CERTIFICATIONS
- Grid of certification badges
- NASM-CPT, ACE, CrossFit Level 2, Precision Nutrition
- Specializations listed
- Continuing education commitment

4. SERVICES OFFERED
- 1-on-1 Personal Training
- Online Coaching Programs
- Nutrition Planning
- Group Training Sessions
- Corporate Wellness Programs
- Each with description, pricing starting from, and "Learn More"

5. TRAINING PROGRAMS
- Program cards with images:
  - 12-Week Body Transformation
  - Strength Building
  - Weight Loss
  - Athletic Performance
  - Post-Pregnancy Fitness
- What's included, duration, price range

6. CLIENT TRANSFORMATIONS
- Before/after photo gallery
- Client name, duration, results achieved
- Brief testimonial quote
- Slider or carousel format

7. TESTIMONIALS
- Video testimonials if available
- Written reviews with photos
- Star ratings
- Specific results mentioned

8. FREE RESOURCES
- Lead magnet: "Download My Free 7-Day Workout Plan"
- Email signup form
- Links to YouTube videos or blog posts

9. BOOKING SECTION
- Calendar integration for consultations
- Available time slots
- Session types dropdown
- Contact form fallback

10. FAQ
- Common questions about training style, pricing, cancellation policy
- Accordion format

Design: Clean, professional with energetic accents. Color scheme: Deep charcoal with coral (#FF6B6B) accents. Large photos showcasing personality. Mobile-optimized contact buttons.
